text: [excited] This delivery drone dropped off a bottle of shampoo... [gasps] then crashed onto the neighbor's garage!
Friday, in Michigan. The app said: arriving by drone in seven minutes. [impressed] And it did!
[nervous] But flying away, it clipped a cable... lost a propeller...
[laughing] and flapped off like a sick bird, a neighbor said... right into a power line.
[deadpan] The power company had to switch the house off.
Nobody was hurt. Getting it down took three hours.
[amused] The neighbor got a hundred-dollar gift card. Air safety officials are investigating.
[playfully] Would you let a drone deliver to your house? Send this to someone who orders everything.
